jobs.description: Silver refresh of the 주택인허가 기본개요 lane `housing-permit-basis-outline` (root ADR-0169 ②, ADR-0511): pick the newest complete hub.go.kr release in the Bronze ledger and, unless silver.housing_permit_basis_outline already records it or a newer one (`unchanged`), export it, stage it on a load branch, compare it with the table's current rows in one bucket and append to main only the changed approvals' rows and a removal marker per vanished approval (keyed by the provider's 관리주택대장PK; lane contract compare.content_columns; root ADR-0318), and read it back (`changed`). Started when a source_sweep run lands new files, and daily as the fallback (root ADR-0171). One lane runs at a time: each takes the compose `spark` cap.

first_run.estimated_from: computed, about 2.5x the nearest larger measured neighbours on the same template unit (root ADR-0386): silver_refresh_building_permit_basis_outline 357 s for a 438 MB release, _parking 251 s for 59 MB, _demolition_loss 161 s for 15 MB; this lane's newest release is 7.6 MB (56 MB unzipped, 381,382 rows) in R2 (2026-11-11)

expected_outcome.basis: building HUB files are released monthly (expected_cadence monthly, 1080 h, in the endpoint catalog) plus one daily fallback; this lane has not run yet, so its first change is its first load (root ADR-0457).

assets.title: 주택인허가 기본개요
assets.description: 주택건설사업계획승인마다 한 행: 승인일·착공예정일·착공일·사용검사예정일·사용검사일과 용도·구조·주건축물수·연면적·총세대수. 아파트·다세대 단지가 언제 승인되고 착공해 언제 입주(사용검사)하는지 말한다. 관리주택대장PK 가 키다. 원문 29칸 보존. 필지 by-PNU 종류 parcel-building-permits 가 행의 PNU 로 필지 문서의 목록 하나(housing_permits)로 싣는다(루트 ADR-0511 §2).

dependencies.description: 주택인허가 기본개요(mart_jty_01) 29칸을 관리주택대장PK 마다 바뀐 승인만 append-only Silver 로 쌓는다(루트 ADR-0511).
dependencies.pnu_resolution: pnu composed at Silver by the Rust hub/VWorld export (export-*-silver-handoff, standard_pnu_from_hub_register_codes / ADR-0145), not a raw provider code; parcels since merged, split or recoded are carried to the current pnu by the consumer through the place-identity resolver and views.changed_codes (ADR-0288, ADR-0329, ADR-0402)
